title: TWIN TUG
oneLiner: Both players tug a runaway star through a maze of shifting walls before it escapes!
mechanics: Player one is the red tugger; player two is the blue tugger.
Move around the shared arena and pull the star by touching it.
A fires a short-range tether; B gives the star a quick shove.
Collect sparks for shared points while walls shift faster over time.

controls.a: Fire tether to pull the star

lose: The star reaches an arena edge or both players are stunned at once.
scoring: Collect sparks and guide the star through bonus gates.
